[LGRA.6.6.7] The compiler must reject a duplicate `cooldown` on the same
rule with `DS_PARSE_DUP_RATE_MOD` ([LCDB.7.8]), and a negative duration with
`DS_VALIDATE_RATE_NEGATIVE_DURATION`. `0_s` is legal
but degenerate (no-op at runtime — the rate-allow gate
emits but always permits the fire).
